reviews.question: Should the Bruma mean and median be reported as the same statistic?
reviews.answer: No. The Bruma median was 18 and the mean was 24; the source says they are not equivalent. [fixture 14, p. 1](nodus://review-source/review-d1f054bc08794b03cd830dcc/4)
